title: Opening up about feeling burned out
situation: You text a close friend late at night to admit you've been feeling overwhelmed and stressed about everything lately.
tip: When you're the one venting, friends respond best to short honest lines; let them react and 되묻기 (왜?/무슨 일인데?) instead of dumping everything at once.

turns.prompt: Say you're up and admit you can't sleep.

choices.ko: 아니 안 자 ㅋㅋ 요즘 잠이 안 와
choices.en: Nope, still up lol I can't really sleep these days
choices.feedback: Casual 아니 안 자 plus a small honest hint opens the door for them to ask more.

choices.ko: 아직 취침 전입니다.
choices.en: I have not yet gone to bed. (formal)
choices.feedback: 취침 전입니다 is stiff 존댓말 — nobody texts a close friend like this.

choices.ko: 응 잘 자.
choices.en: Yeah, goodnight.
choices.feedback: Shuts the chat down right when they were checking in on you.

turns.ko: 왜? 무슨 일 있어? 너 요즘 좀 다운돼 보이더라
turns.en: Why, is something up? You've seemed kind of down lately.

choices.ko: 그냥 좀… 요즘 다 벅차 ㅠㅠ 번아웃 온 거 같아
choices.en: Just kinda… everything feels like too much lately ㅠㅠ I think I'm burned out
choices.feedback: Honest but short — 다 벅차 + 번아웃 is exactly how 20-30s name this feeling, and it invites them in.

choices.ko: 심리적 압박감이 상당히 누적된 상태입니다.
choices.en: A considerable amount of psychological pressure has accumulated. (formal)
choices.feedback: Reads like a report — way too clinical and formal for venting to a friend.

choices.ko: 아니야 별일 아니야 신경 쓰지 마.
choices.en: No it's nothing, don't worry about it.
choices.feedback: Brushes them off and closes up — defeats the point of opening the chat.

turns.ko: 헐… 그랬구나 ㅠㅠ 혼자 끙끙 앓지 말고 진작 말하지 그랬어
turns.en: Oh no… I had no idea ㅠㅠ You should've told me sooner instead of bottling it up alone.

turns.prompt: Thank them and admit it's hard to say out loud.

choices.ko: ㅠㅠ 고마워 막상 말하려니까 좀 그렇더라
choices.en: ㅠㅠ thanks, it's just kinda hard to actually say it out loud
choices.feedback: Warm and real — 막상 말하려니까 그렇더라 is a very natural way to admit it's awkward to open up.

choices.ko: 경청해 주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다.
choices.en: I sincerely thank you for listening. (formal)
choices.feedback: 감사드립니다 is business-letter formal — kills the intimate moment.

choices.ko: 근데 너 주말에 뭐 해?
choices.en: Anyway what are you doing this weekend?
choices.feedback: Abruptly changes the subject right when they're being caring.

turns.ko: 야 우리 내일 만나서 얘기하자 내가 맛있는 거 사줄게
turns.en: Hey let's meet tomorrow and talk, I'll buy you something tasty

turns.prompt: Accept gratefully and show it means a lot.

choices.ko: 헐 진짜? ㅠㅠ 너 덕분에 좀 살 거 같다 고마워
choices.en: Wait really? ㅠㅠ honestly you're kind of saving me here, thank you
choices.feedback: 헐 진짜? + 너 덕분에 살 거 같다 is heartfelt and casual (use 덕분에, not 때문에, when you're grateful) — the perfect close to a vent.

choices.ko: 그럼 내일 일정을 조율해 보도록 하겠습니다.
choices.en: Then I shall coordinate my schedule for tomorrow. (formal)
choices.feedback: Sounds like scheduling a work meeting — totally wrong register for a friend.

choices.ko: 아니야 안 사줘도 돼 그냥 둬.
choices.en: No you don't have to buy anything, just leave it.
choices.feedback: Reflexively refusing the kindness shuts down their warm offer.

title: Comforting a friend having a rough time
situation: A friend texts you out of nowhere saying they're going through a really rough patch and feel like everything's falling apart.
tip: When comforting someone, validate the feeling first (얼마나 힘들어/그럴 만하지) and avoid jumping to solutions — let 맞장구 and gentle 되묻기 do the work.

turns.ko: 나 요즘 진짜 다 무너지는 기분이야 ㅠㅠ
turns.en: Lately I genuinely feel like everything's falling apart ㅠㅠ

turns.prompt: Validate first and gently ask what's going on.

choices.ko: 헐… 무슨 일이야? 많이 힘들었구나 ㅠㅠ
choices.en: Oh no… what's going on? you've been having such a hard time ㅠㅠ
choices.feedback: Validates the feeling (많이 힘들었구나) before asking — exactly what someone hurting needs first.

choices.ko: 구체적으로 어떤 상황인지 설명해 주시겠어요?
choices.en: Could you explain the specific situation? (formal)
choices.feedback: 설명해 주시겠어요 is cold 존댓말 — sounds like a survey, not a friend.

choices.ko: 야 그래도 너보다 힘든 사람 많아.
choices.en: Hey, still, there are people way worse off than you.
choices.feedback: Minimizes their pain — the opposite of comforting.

turns.ko: 일도 꼬이고 사람한테도 상처받고… 그냥 다 놓고 싶어
turns.en: Work's a mess and people hurt me too… I just wanna let it all go

turns.prompt: Acknowledge how heavy that is without fixing it.

choices.ko: 그럴 만하지… 한꺼번에 몰리면 진짜 버겁잖아
choices.en: No wonder… when it all piles up at once it's genuinely too much
choices.feedback: 그럴 만하지 normalizes the feeling and 버겁잖아 shows you really get it — pure comfort, no lecture.

choices.ko: 그럴 때일수록 긍정적으로 생각하셔야 합니다.
choices.en: At times like these you must think positively. (formal)
choices.feedback: A 존댓말 pep-talk lecture — invalidating and the last thing they want to hear.

choices.ko: 그래서 그 사람이 정확히 뭐라고 했는데?
choices.en: So what exactly did that person say to you?
choices.feedback: Digs for gossip details instead of sitting with their feelings.

turns.ko: 응 ㅠㅠ 요즘 그냥 아무것도 하기 싫고 무기력해
turns.en: Yeah ㅠㅠ lately I just don't wanna do anything, I feel so drained

turns.prompt: Reassure them it's okay to rest right now.

choices.ko: 그럴 땐 좀 쉬어도 돼 진짜. 너 충분히 잘하고 있어
choices.en: It's totally okay to rest when you feel like that. you're doing more than enough
choices.feedback: Permission to rest + 충분히 잘하고 있어 is warm, affirming comfort — exactly right.

choices.ko: 무기력증은 전문가 상담을 권장드립니다.
choices.en: For lethargy, professional counseling is recommended. (formal)
choices.feedback: Robotic 존댓말 advice — reads like a pamphlet, not a friend who cares.

choices.ko: 에이 그러다 진짜 큰일 나, 정신 차려.
choices.en: Come on, keep that up and you're in real trouble, snap out of it.
choices.feedback: Scolding tone — pressures them instead of comforting them.

turns.ko: 고마워 ㅠㅠ 진짜 네 말 들으니까 좀 위로된다
turns.en: Thank you ㅠㅠ hearing you say that actually comforts me

turns.prompt: Let them know you're always there for them.

choices.ko: 언제든 연락해 진짜. 나 항상 네 편이야
choices.en: Reach out anytime, I mean it. I'm always on your side
choices.feedback: 나 항상 네 편이야 is the perfect close — open, warm, and reassuring.

choices.ko: 도움이 되셨다니 다행스럽게 생각합니다.
choices.en: I'm glad to hear I was of help. (formal)
choices.feedback: 다행스럽게 생각합니다 is stiff 존댓말 — too businesslike for a heart-to-heart.

choices.ko: 그래 그럼 난 이만 잘게.
choices.en: Okay then, I'm gonna head to bed now.
choices.feedback: Bailing the moment they open up feels cold and abrupt.

title: Ranting about an annoying roommate
situation: You're hanging out at a cafe and your friend starts ranting about their messy, inconsiderate roommate.
tip: For a 'this is so annoying' rant, your job is to be on their side — pile on with 맞장구 (헐/대박/그니까) and 되묻기 (그래서 뭐래?) so they feel backed up.

turns.ko: 아 진짜 나 룸메 때문에 미치겠어
turns.en: Ugh seriously my roommate is driving me insane

turns.prompt: Take their side and ask what happened this time.

choices.ko: 헐 또 왜? 무슨 일인데 ㅋㅋ
choices.en: Ugh what now? what happened lol
choices.feedback: 헐 또 왜? immediately takes their side and pulls the story out — perfect rant fuel.

choices.ko: 룸메이트분과 갈등이 있으신가요?
choices.en: Are you having a conflict with your roommate? (formal)
choices.feedback: 갈등이 있으신가요 is 존댓말 — absurdly formal when you're sitting right across from them.

choices.ko: 룸메랑 같이 사는 거 원래 힘들어.
choices.en: Living with a roommate is hard in general.
choices.feedback: A flat generalization that doesn't react or invite the story.

turns.ko: 설거지를 일주일째 안 해 ㅋㅋㅋ 싱크대에 그릇이 산더미야
turns.en: They haven't done dishes in a week lol the sink is a literal mountain of plates

choices.ko: 헐 대박 ㅋㅋㅋ 일주일?? 그걸 어떻게 참아
choices.en: Whoa no way lol a whole week?? how do you even put up with that
choices.feedback: Big reaction (대박) + 그걸 어떻게 참아 backs them up and keeps the rant rolling.

choices.ko: 위생상 좋지 않으니 즉시 처리해야 합니다.
choices.en: It's unhygienic so it should be dealt with immediately. (formal)
choices.feedback: A hygiene lecture in 존댓말 — kills the vibe and sides with no one.

choices.ko: 넌 설거지 바로바로 하는 편이야?
choices.en: Do you tend to do your dishes right away?
choices.feedback: Flips the focus onto you instead of backing them up.

turns.ko: 그러게 ㅋㅋ 어제는 한마디 했더니 알겠다고만 하고 또 안 함
turns.en: Right lol yesterday I said something and they just went 'okay' and still didn't do it

turns.prompt: Share their frustration and dig for more.

choices.ko: 와 그게 더 빡치지 ㅋㅋ 그래서 너 뭐라고 했어?
choices.en: Ugh that's even more infuriating lol so what did you say to them?
choices.feedback: 그게 더 빡치지 matches their anger and 그래서 뭐라고 했어? keeps the story going.

choices.ko: 원만한 대화로 해결하시길 권합니다.
choices.en: I recommend resolving it through amicable conversation. (formal)
choices.feedback: Sounds like an HR memo — formal and preachy, not what a ranting friend wants.

choices.ko: 근데 우리 뭐 마실지 안 정했다.
choices.en: Anyway we still haven't decided what to drink.
choices.feedback: Changes the subject mid-rant — leaves them hanging.

turns.ko: 그냥 포기했어 ㅋㅋㅋ 결국 내가 치워야지 뭐
turns.en: I just gave up lol I guess I'll have to clean it myself in the end.

turns.prompt: Sympathize and lightly side with them.

choices.ko: 에휴 고생이다 진짜 ㅋㅋ 넌 너무 착하다
choices.en: Aw what a pain seriously lol you're way too nice
choices.feedback: 고생이다 + 넌 너무 착하다 (the -다 exclamatory ending is super natural here) sympathizes and subtly takes their side — a natural rant wrap-up.

choices.ko: 갈등 해결을 위해 규칙을 정립하시는 게 어떨까요?
choices.en: How about establishing rules to resolve the conflict? (formal)
choices.feedback: 규칙을 정립하시는 is stiff 존댓말 — overly solution-y for a casual vent.

choices.ko: 그러게 왜 그런 애랑 같이 살아.
choices.en: Yeah well, why even live with someone like that.
choices.feedback: Blames them for the situation instead of being on their side.
